title: Oracle dispatch configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine and $C$ a finite Boolean Turing machine with $C$ having at least one work tape. For any Boolean input $x$, any configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, any side in $\\{\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{true}\\}$, and any configuration $d$ with four work tapes and an oracle-dispatch state on $x$, the construction returns a configuration of $M.k+ C.k+3$ work tapes on $x$, with the oracle-dispatch state type, obtained by embedding the work-tape contents and head positions of the source configuration into the host tapes and taking the input-head position and state from $d$, with empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$x$ is a list of Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration with $M.k+1$ work tapes and state type $M$'s
$d$ is a configuration with four work tapes and oracle-dispatch states
caveat: The statement relies on omitted definitions of the source configuration and embedding; their precise tape placement and which fields are inherited cannot be determined from the supplied snippet.
